newsitem.title: EGYPT: Israel's Netanyahu in Egypt for peace summit.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu in Egypt for peace summit.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu arrived on Tuesday in this Egyptian Red Sea resort for crisis talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on reviving the Middle East peace process.
Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak was already in Sharm el-Sheikh waiting for Netanyahu, who arrived with his foreign minister David Levy.
Israel's building of Jewish settlements on Arab lands it occupied in the 1967 Middle East war has halted Palestinian-Israeli peace talks.

Egypt, which considers itself the unofficial sponsor of the talks, supports the Palestinian demand for stopping settlement building before resuming talks but has also said it would listen to Israel's suggestions on restarting talks.
